title: Provider-neutral structural approval receipt v2
description: Positive-only human consent for exactly one content-equivalent send. The receipt binds an immutable generation and manifest, one email-approved-content.v1 digest, one provider account, one effective recipient, one reply thread, one idempotency key, an expiry, a single authenticated approval channel, and a required JobTrack Ed25519 machine attestation. Rejections are separate review-domain events and cannot instantiate this contract. It is not standing authority: the send edge must resolve and verify the pinned JobTrack public key, independently authenticate the channel, rehash the content, resolve the inbound thread/effective recipient, enforce expiry, and consume the one-send idempotency key.

decision.description: This receipt records positive authority only. A rejection is a separate review-domain event and never enters a send request.

idempotencyKey.description: The one-send key approved by the human; email-send-request.v2 and email-send-receipt.v2 must repeat it exactly.

approvedContentDigest.description: Canonical SHA-256 of the complete email-approved-content.v1 instance displayed to the human.

scope.description: The complete least-authority send scope. Every field is repeated by email-send-request.v2 and compared exactly by the send edge.

authenticatedChannel.description: Opaque proof reference for the fixed authenticated approval ingress. The value records authentication but never grants authority independently of all other bindings.

attestation.description: Required JobTrack machine attestation. Ed25519 signs the UTF-8 bytes of the package-canonical JSON approval payload obtained by removing this complete attestation property. payloadDigest is SHA-256 of those same canonical bytes. keyId is resolved only through the consumer's pinned JobTrack approval-key registry.

signature.description: Canonical padded base64 encoding of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature.
